git.enableHint: Branches and pull requests that contain an issue key are linked automatically.
git.connectionHint: Connect a repository from GitHub, GitLab, Gitea, Forgejo, or Bitbucket.
git.webhookEndpointHint: One endpoint receives branch, pull request, and CI updates from every connected repository.
git.secretRegenerated: New secret created. Update it in your repository webhook too.
git.hintGithub: Repository Settings → Webhooks → Add webhook. Paste both values above, set the content type to application/json, then select Pull requests, Check runs, and branch Create/Delete events.
git.hintGitlab: Project Settings → Webhooks → Add new webhook. Paste the URL, put the secret in Secret token, and enable Merge request, Pipeline, and Push events.
git.hintGitea: Repository Settings → Webhooks → Add webhook, type Gitea (Forgejo on Forgejo). Paste both values above and enable pull request plus branch create/delete events.
git.hintBitbucket: Repository Settings → Webhooks → Add webhook. Paste both values above and select pull request plus branch created/deleted events.
git.cliHint: Needs the GitHub CLI. Replace {placeholder} with your repository and run it in a terminal.
git.gitlabCliHint: Needs the <link>GitLab CLI</link>. Run this command from the repository directory.
git.commandCopied: Command copied. Replace owner/repo, then run it.
git.nativeConnectionsHint: Authorize a Git provider, choose repositories, and let Plan configure their webhooks.
git.nativeNoConnections: No provider accounts connected yet. Manual webhook setup remains available below.
git.nativeAskTeamManager: Ask a team owner or manager to connect a provider account.

nativeTokenHint.github: Use a fine-grained token with Metadata read, Webhooks write, and Pull requests write access for the repositories you want to connect.
nativeTokenHint.gitlab: Use a personal access token with API access. Only projects where you are a Maintainer or Owner are listed.
nativeTokenHint.gitea: Use an access token that can administer hooks in the repositories you want to connect.
nativeTokenHint.forgejo: Use an access token that can administer hooks in the repositories you want to connect.
nativeTokenHint.bitbucket: Use a Bitbucket Cloud access token that can read your user, workspaces, and repositories, administer repository webhooks, and comment on pull requests.

git.nativeTokenStored: The token is encrypted at rest and is never returned by the API.

git.nativeRepositoryLimit: Connect up to 50 repositories at a time.
git.nativeDisconnectConfirm: Disconnect {provider} and remove every webhook managed by Plan?
git.gitlabCommandCopied: Command copied. Run it from the repository directory.
git.repositoriesHint: Repositories that most recently delivered an event to this project.
git.automationsHint: An issue key in a branch name links it automatically. Pull request magic words control merge automation; “Skip KEY-123” removes an existing link too.
